title: Aston Villa’s Youri Tielemans returns to training after two-month injury absence
content:
Youri Tielemans has returned to training and is in contention to make Aston Villa’s squad for Sunday’s home match with West Ham United.

Earlier this week, there had been growing optimism from sources close to the situation, speaking on the condition of anonymity to protect relationships, that Tielemans would return before the international break, which had been ahead of previous expectations.

Tielemans trained with the players who did not feature in the 3-0 on aggregate win over Lille in the Europa League on Thursday night and could be available to play on Sunday. Should he be deemed to come through successfully, there is a chance he may feature in Sunday’s matchday squad.

The Belgium international, 28, has not played since sustaining an ankle injury away at Newcastle United in January and was a key absentee along with fellow midfielders Boubacar Kamara and John McGinn that contributed to Villa’s downturn in form.

Despite not playing for more than two months, Tielemans was called up by Belgium for the upcoming friendly matches against the USMNT and Mexico.

Villa sit fourth in the Premier League, two points ahead of fifth-placed Liverpool and three in front of Chelsea in sixth.
